heading: Congressional Record: maps; diagrams; illustrations
lead: Maps, diagrams, or illustrations may not be inserted in the Record without the approval of the Joint Committee on Printing.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 182b (Jan. 12, 1895, ch. 23, § 14, as added June 20, 1936, ch. 630, title II, § 2, 49 Stat. 1546).
